notes: ALP dark matter decay search using WINERED spectrograph on Magellan Clay telescope, observing dSphs Leo V and Tucana II. Constrains photon coupling g_phi_gamma_gamma for ALP DM decaying to two photons in mass range 1.8-2.7 eV. Quoted bound g ~ (2-3)e-11 GeV^-1 for NFW profile (~1e-10 GeV^-1 for generalized Hernquist). Data points approximated from text/Fig 1 (NFW profile case); exact per-bin values in supplementary files not extractable here. This is a decaying-DM indirect search based on D-factors (column density), not a haloscope, so no local DM density assumed.
